en-US.title: wheredwepark
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's new in 1.1:
• Notifications: get notified when someone shares a vehicle with you, and choose to be notified whenever someone parks a shared vehicle (turn it on for each vehicle).
• Better support for larger text: the app now follows your iPhone's text size setting.
• Keyboard fixes: text boxes and buttons no longer get hidden behind the keyboard when you add a vehicle or write a parking note.
• New guide to parking automatically with Siri and Shortcuts, under Settings → Auto-park with Siri.
• Invitations now show the sender's email address, so you know who they're from.
• New About screen, with credit to DoodlesByRay for the app's artwork and icon.
• Security improvements, including safer password reset links. Open the reset email on the same phone you requested it from.
